source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-10: Once in Whispers

items.name: Cybernetics
items.text: The cybernetics of a cybernetic zombie can be disabled for 1 hour with a successful disable-device dc=19 check. A zombie's cybernetics are disabled for 1 hour if it takes any electricity damage. A cybernetic zombie with disabled cybernetics is Slowed 1 and can't use reactions (including self-destruct).

items.name: Self Destruct
items.text:
A cybernetic zombie must use this reaction unless its cybernetics are disabled

Trigger The cybernetic zombie is reduced to 0 Hit Points

---
Effect The zombie's damaged cybernetics explode, dealing 3d8+2 electricity damage in a 10-foot radius (DC 19 basic Reflex save save). This ability destroys any technological items on the zombie.

items.name: Short Circuit
items.text: The sparking zombie has been implanted with tech components that have malfunctioned and are crackling with electricity. A creature that hits the zombie with an unarmed Strike takes 5 electricity damage.
